observations: All six named views are present, legible and uncropped. Front cabin, rear platform, crane position, rail-bound bogies and opposite front/rear lamp language maintain vehicle identity.

FRONT, REAR and both profiles show short rail samples. Orange wraparound bogies and low dark rollers visibly communicate captive guidance. Full physical under-flange retention and clearance remain unproved by these illustrations.
AT WORK is supported by an existing complete bridge. The crane holds a strapped load from a hook and sling over a freight platform; there are no wings, rotors, balloons or free flight.
Representative cargo blocks shift presentation in the rear view; this is a concept-load limitation, not a demonstrated cargo capacity or locked load-placement blueprint.
